pairing.title: Pair your devices
pairing.intro: Pair your belt and your wrist band with this phone. It takes about a minute.

choose.title: Choose your {{device}}
choose.body: Turn the {{device}} on and keep it close to this phone. Pick the name printed on its label.
choose.none: No {{device}} found nearby. Check that it is turned on, then look again.

confirm.title: Is this your {{device}}?
confirm.body: Check that the name matches the label on your {{device}}.
confirm.name: Name
confirm.match: The name matches the label on my {{device}}

error.already_bound: This {{device}} is already linked to another account, so it cannot be paired here. Choose a different one, or ask your barangay health worker for help.
error.not_found: We lost contact with the {{device}}. Please look again.
error.type_taken: A {{device}} is already paired to your account.
error.match: Tick the box to confirm the name matches.

done.title: All set
done.bothBody: Your belt and wrist band are paired. You can start your first check from Home.

pairing.skipNote: You can pair your devices later from Home.
